# 🌲 VectorLess RAG — Tree-Based Document Q&A

A RAG system that answers questions from documents **without any vector embeddings or similarity search** — instead it uses a **LLM-navigated document tree** built by [PageIndex](https://pageindex.ai) to find relevant sections.

---

## 💡 The Core Idea

Traditional RAG:
```
Document → Chunk → Embed → FAISS → Similarity Search → Answer
```

VectorLess RAG:
```
Document → PageIndex Tree → LLM Tree Search → Relevant Nodes → Answer
```

Instead of embedding chunks and doing cosine similarity, the document is parsed into a **hierarchical tree** (like a smart Table of Contents with full section text). An LLM then reads the tree structure and decides which nodes are relevant to the query — no vectors, no embeddings, no FAISS.

---

## ✨ Features

- Zero vector embeddings — no FAISS, no sentence-transformers
- LLM-guided tree traversal to find relevant document sections
- Section-level citations in every answer (title + page number)
- Streamlit UI with step-by-step pipeline visibility
- Supports PDF, TXT, and DOCX

---

## 🏗️ Architecture

```
Upload Document
      │
      ▼
PageIndex API
      ├── submit_document()     # upload & parse
      ├── build_llm_tree()      # async tree build (poll until complete)
      └── get_tree()            # hierarchical node tree with summaries
                │
                ▼
        Document Tree (nodes with title, page, text)
                │
                ▼
        llm_tree_search(query, tree)
